identifier_encoding: domain + SHA256(JSON compact [domain, original parts]) first 20 hex; pseudonymous, not anonymous
null_policy: CSV blank = unknown/not present; size_key MISSING preserves unknown identity; never numeric zero

abc_comparison.denominator: 208 references or MIN demand_denominator_units for quantity share

cumulative_customer_units.definition: Fixed full-extract demand cumulative through ranked reference; never sum.

customer_units.definition: Sum of published customer quantities in the declared group or interpretation.

demand_denominator_units.definition: Full customer demand (228195) repeated per alternative/reference; use MIN, never SUM.

derived_abc.definition: Extract-volume 80/95 ABC using cumulative share BEFORE each reference; ties by original reference ascending.

disagrees.definition: 1 if published and derived ABC differ; not a confirmed source error.

published_abc.definition: Product.ABCCOD as published; basis and effective date unverified.

rank.definition: One-based descending quantity rank; original source key ascending breaks ties.

reference_id.definition: Stable domain-separated SHA-256 pseudonym (20 hex digits). String dimension; not proof of anonymization.

quantity.definition: Picking units for Picking_Wave, nonempty encoded cells for allocation files; consult unit.

records.definition: Source records contributing to location; for allocation each row counted once, not once per cell.

scope_denominator.definition: Full same-source quantity (picking units or all raw nonempty allocation cells), repeated per location.

source_scope.definition: Pinned source filename (without personal data), original field name or exact profile check name.

unit.definition: published picking units or encoded allocation cells; populations cannot be mixed.

unknown_reference_cells.definition: Nonempty allocation cells absent from Product.Reference; may overlap unmapped cells.

field.definition: Pinned source filename (without personal data), original field name or exact profile check name.

original_token.definition: Exact source size spelling, including whitespace; blank means original missing size.

token_records.definition: Records with exactly this original token in this source.

token_units.definition: Published quantity on records with exactly this original token.

distinct_references.definition: Distinct members within a group; counts overlap between groups.

distinct_size_skus.definition: Distinct members within a group; counts overlap between groups.

missing_size_records.definition: Source records satisfying named check in the group; checks can overlap.

order_group_id.definition: Stable domain-separated SHA-256 pseudonym (20 hex digits). String dimension; not proof of anonymization.

order_id.definition: Stable domain-separated SHA-256 pseudonym (20 hex digits). String dimension; not proof of anonymization.

order_wave_count.definition: Distinct source waves for this order pseudonym; repeated per wave/order group.

repeat_records.definition: Complete original tuple occurrences after first in source; retained in current calculations.

wave_id.definition: Stable domain-separated SHA-256 pseudonym (20 hex digits). String dimension; not proof of anonymization.

zero_quantity_records.definition: Source records satisfying named check in the group; checks can overlap.

policy_pairs.denominator: union_skus per pair; no across-pair SUM

l1_cell_difference.definition: Sum of absolute pair SKU-counter differences; not required moves, stock loss or unique units.

policy_a.definition: Published configuration name or unordered pair. Alternative configurations are not additive.

policy_b.definition: Published configuration name or unordered pair. Alternative configurations are not additive.

policy_pair_id.definition: Published configuration name or unordered pair. Alternative configurations are not additive.

union_skus.definition: Union of coordinate-retained reference/size keys in this pair.

conditional_supply_ceiling.definition: Existing M3 sum min(full-history SKU demand, retained encoded-cell count); one undated snapshot/no receipts assumption.

demand_denominator_units.definition: Full customer demand (228195) repeated per alternative/reference; use MIN, never SUM.

excluded_cells.definition: Nonempty cells without joined coordinate IDs; preserved in source.

policy.definition: Published configuration name or unordered pair. Alternative configurations are not additive.

raw_encoded_cells.definition: Nonempty numbered allocation cells before coordinate exclusion.

retained_encoded_cells.definition: Nonempty cells with joined coordinate IDs; each assumed one unit, physical stock unverified.

policy_supply.grain: one published policy, existing M3 stock arithmetic only

profile_checks.denominator: population_rows for that source/check, including zero results

check.definition: Pinned source filename (without personal data), original field name or exact profile check name.

field.definition: Pinned source filename (without personal data), original field name or exact profile check name.

population_rows.definition: Full named source record denominator; repeated across checks.

source_id.definition: Pinned source filename (without personal data), original field name or exact profile check name.

current_customer_units.definition: Customer quantity at key under existing inferred size mapping; zeros/repeats retained.

dedup_customer_records.definition: Contributing source-record count for named branch, including zero quantities. Presence is count > 0.

literal_customer_records.definition: Contributing source-record count for named branch, including zero quantities. Presence is count > 0.

picking_records.definition: Contributing source-record count for named branch, including zero quantities. Presence is count > 0.

picking_units.definition: Published picking quantity at this key/location, all repeat occurrences retained.

wave_id.definition: Stable domain-separated SHA-256 pseudonym (20 hex digits). String dimension; not proof of anonymization.
